method: One temporary issue, 30 sequential GETs one second apart, deleted afterwards. Timing surrounds httpx.Client.get, including network and response download. Readiness and creation precede the measured GETs.
limitation: Client-observed sample, not a Grafana/server SLI report or a seven-day reliability measurement. Includes cached reads; does not cover cold starts, load, provider failures or 200 responses with incorrect contents. No issue IDs, titles or credentials retained.
